footer.tagline: Turning waste into art, and art into impact.

home.heroSubtitle: RenewCanvas Africa connects recycled materials with talented artists to create unique, impact-verified artwork. Every piece tells a story of transformation.
home.aboutP1: RenewCanvas Africa is a technology-driven circular arts platform that transforms the waste crisis into creative opportunity. We collect specific recyclable materials, distribute them to curated artists, and connect their unique creations with buyers who value sustainability and impact.
home.aboutP2: Every artwork on our platform comes with a verified environmental impact story, so you will know exactly how much waste was diverted, which artist created it, and the journey from discarded material to treasured art piece.
home.aboutP3: We are not just a marketplace. We are a movement to prove that waste can be beautiful, that African artists deserve global recognition, and that conscious consumers can make a real difference.
home.howTitle: From Waste to Wonder in Four Steps
home.howSubtitle: Our platform creates a transparent, traceable journey from discarded materials to cherished artwork.
home.step1Desc: We source recyclable materials (plastics, fabrics, metals) from verified partners, clean and sort them for artistic use.
home.step2Desc: Our curated artists transform these materials into stunning paintings, sculptures, jewelry, and home décor.
home.step3Desc: Every artwork is logged with its environmental impact: kg of waste diverted, materials used, and artist earnings.
home.step4Desc: Purchase unique art, commission custom pieces, or sponsor donations to schools. Every action creates real impact.
home.impactSubtitle: Every purchase on RenewCanvas Africa contributes to measurable environmental and social impact.
home.statArtworksDesc: Unique pieces with verified impact stories
home.whyTitle: Art With Purpose, Impact With Proof
home.whySubtitle: RenewCanvas Africa is not just another art marketplace. We are building a transparent, traceable circular economy for creative expression.
home.why1Desc: Every artwork comes with documented environmental impact: kg of waste diverted and materials traced.
home.why2Desc: Our artists are vetted for skill and commitment. You are buying from talented, verified creators.
home.why3Desc: Celebrating African creativity and craftsmanship while solving a local environmental challenge.
home.why4Desc: Support school donations, artist training, and community clean-up initiatives through your purchase.
home.ctaSubtitle: Whether you want to buy unique art, join as an artist, or partner with us for corporate impact, there is a place for you in the RenewCanvas community.

marketplace.heroSubtitle: Browse our collection of stunning artwork created from recycled materials and discover unique pieces by independent and professional artists. Each piece comes with verified environmental impact.
marketplace.comingSoonDesc: We are currently onboarding talented artists and curating our first collection of unique upcycled artwork. Be the first to know when we launch!
marketplace.lookingDesc: Sign up to be notified when our marketplace launches. Get early access to exclusive upcycled artwork with verified impact stories.
marketplace.areYouArtistDesc: Join our platform and showcase your upcycled creations to buyers who value sustainability. We provide materials and support.

artwork.renewOwnedDesc: This is platform-owned inventory. Revenue belongs to RenewCanvas after payment and delivery costs.
artwork.artistOwnedDesc: Artist-owned artwork. RenewCanvas mediates payment, delivery, and post-delivery payout release.

artistDashboard.welcomeSub: Manage your artworks, track orders, and grow your creative business.
artistDashboard.environmentalImpactDesc: Total waste diverted through your artworks.

adminImpact.title: Impact Dashboard
adminImpact.subtitle: Track and manage environmental impact metrics

checkout.momoDesc: Pay RenewCanvas Africa by approving the MoMo prompt on your phone
checkout.bankDesc: Transfer to the RenewCanvas Africa holding account
checkout.cardDesc: Pay RenewCanvas Africa with Visa or Mastercard
checkout.managedPaymentNote: Buyers pay RenewCanvas Africa directly. We confirm the order, coordinate delivery, and release the artist payout only after the 48-hour return request window closes without an approved return.
checkout.trustHoldsPayment: RenewCanvas receives and holds buyer payment
